# Copilot instructions

This repository's rules live in `AGENTS.md` at the root. Read it before answering or editing.

The minimum, in case `AGENTS.md` is not in context:

- Read `INDEX.md` first, open only the needed section by line range from `90_System/index.json`, and never read a file over 300 lines whole.
- Never read or quote `**/.env` or plugin `data.json` files.
- Do not invent references: a paper needs a verifiable arXiv ID or DOI.
- File and folder names use underscores instead of spaces.
- What was not checked says "not verified".
- Concept, reference and guide notes keep the two headings in `90_System/Specs/study_layer.json` first and second.
